Interface JobsRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Job,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Job,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaSpecificationExecutor<Job>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Job,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Job,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Job,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Job>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Job,Long>
@Repository public interface JobsRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Job,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaSpecificationExecutor<Job>
Spring Data repository for Job entities. Paging comes from JpaRepository; JpaSpecificationExecutor backs /paginated's optional filters, composed as a dynamic Specification<Job> rather than a combinatorial set of derived-query methods for every combination of filters; scope-based queries support apps that associate jobs with a domain object (see Job.scopeType/Job.scopeId).
